meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个研究问题,拿到带引用、经过复核的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到需要系统查证、逐条引用来源的复杂调研任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face complex questions needing systematic, cited investigation

howto.what: 开启后,Claude 会先问你想要哪种交付格式(如 PDF、DOCX),再组建一个研究团队,分头多路搜集来源、互相辩论、用跑代码来验证有争议的说法,最后交出一份每条结论都带引用或验证证据的报告。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求研究或深度调查时才触发,比如提到 “ulw-research”、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞或 “ultradebate” 等;普通提问和调试不会触发。

say.text: ulw-research:帮我彻底调研 RISC-V 生态现状
say.note: 它会先问你要哪种交付格式

say.text: 用 ulw 深挖一下我们的缓存层为什么慢,要带引用来源
say.note: 组建团队并跑验证脚本

say.text: ultradebate:对比三种向量数据库,争议点用代码验证
say.note: 有争议的结论会先过辩论环节

howto.what_en: Turns on ULW-RESEARCH mode: Claude asks the deliverable format first, then builds a research team that fans out over sources, debates contested claims, proves them by running code, and delivers a cited report.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, e.g. "ulw-research", any "ulw" research wording, or "ultradebate"; ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: ulw-research: do an exhaustive study of the RISC-V ecosystem
say_en.note: It asks your deliverable format first

say_en.text: Use ulw deep research on why our cache layer is slow, with cited sources
say_en.note: Builds a team and runs verification scripts

say_en.text: ultradebate: compare three vector databases, prove disputes with code
say_en.note: Contested claims go through a debate round
